articles.title: Spot size reduction and minibeam creation in a proton PBS nozzle using multipole permanent magnets
articles.summary: This study explores the use of multipole permanent magnets within a proton pencil beam scanning nozzle to reduce spot size. The proposed design facilitates the creation of modulated beams and proton minibeams for potential clinical or preclinical use.

articles.title: Linac performance benchmarking: Feasibility of a web-based tool for comparison of local machine performance check (MPC) results with the global community
articles.summary: This study demonstrates the feasibility of a web-based tool for benchmarking linear accelerator performance against a global database. The tool allows clinics to identify machine trends and may assist under-resourced centers in maintaining safe and accurate radiotherapy delivery.

articles.title: A generalizable 3D dose prediction across heterogeneous cohorts: A framework developed for the 2025 AAPM GDP-HMM challenge
articles.summary: Researchers developed a generalizable 3D dose prediction framework that meets strict runtime requirements while preserving geometric plan features and clinical endpoints. The study highlights the role of engineered loss formulations in achieving cross-institutional model generalization.

articles.title: Daily Multi-Leaf Collimator positional error prediction using machine learning
articles.summary: Researchers developed a machine learning model using LightGBM to predict multi-leaf collimator (MLC) positional errors. This approach offers a potentially efficient tool for patient-specific quality assurance in intensity-modulated radiotherapy.

articles.title: Quantitative assessment of deformable image registration accuracy for cumulative dose estimation in multi-site stereotactic re-irradiation
articles.summary: This study evaluates the accuracy of deformable image registration for tracking cumulative radiation doses in re-irradiation scenarios. The findings support the integration of validated registration tools with biological dose modeling to enhance safety and precision in complex treatment workflows.

articles.title: Impact of anatomical changes on simulated proton arc therapy and intensity-modulated proton therapy for lung cancer
articles.summary: This study demonstrates that simulated proton arc therapy (sPAT) provides superior robustness compared to intensity-modulated proton therapy (IMPT) when addressing inter-fractional anatomical changes in lung cancer patients. The findings highlight potential advantages for treatment planning in lung tumor sites prone to motion.

articles.title: Assessment of Radiation Dose and Volume Changes in the Masticatory Apparatus and their Clinical Correlation with Trismus in Oral Cavity Cancer Patients
articles.summary: Researchers analyzed the correlation between radiation dose, muscle atrophy, and trismus in oral cavity cancer patients. The study suggests that incorporating masticatory muscle sparing into radiation treatment planning is crucial to reducing long-term functional morbidity.

articles.title: Photon Versus Proton Whole-Body Irradiation Combined with Olaparib in C57BL/6 Mice
articles.summary: This study examines the multi-organ oxidative toxicity in mice following whole-body irradiation with either photons or protons, combined with the PARP inhibitor olaparib. The findings provide insights into potential differences in radiosensitizing effects and systemic toxicity between these two radiation modalities.

articles.title: Model-Based Normal Tissue Complication Probability Comparison Between Proton and Photon Therapies for Brain Tumors
articles.summary: This planning comparison study indicates that proton beam therapy may reduce the risk of secondary cancers in patients with brain tumors compared to IMRT, while photon therapy shows advantages regarding specific toxicities like blindness and brain necrosis. The study emphasizes the value of using radiotherapy treatment planning guidelines for objective clinical comparison.

articles.title: Clinical Outcomes and Safety of Spatially Fractionated Radiotherapy for Malignant Tumors
articles.summary: A systematic review evaluating the clinical outcomes and safety profiles of spatially fractionated radiotherapy (SFRT) across various malignant tumors. The report highlights the current evidence base and identifies key considerations for the use of this technique in clinical practice.

articles.title: Six-year data from three magnetic resonance-guided radiotherapy systems demonstrate long-term stability of linear accelerator quality assurance
articles.summary: This study analyzed six years of data from three MR-guided radiotherapy systems to assess the long-term stability of quality assurance programs. The results support a potential reconsideration of traditional QA schedules based on the demonstrated performance consistency.

articles.title: Preliminary evaluation of ProSpare for rectal protection in prostate bed radiotherapy
articles.summary: Results from the multicenter POPS trial indicate that the use of a rectal obturator, ProSpare, during prostate bed radiotherapy leads to a measurable reduction in acute bowel toxicity. Patient-reported outcomes and dosimetric improvements support its potential utility in clinical settings.

articles.title: Artificial Intelligence, Multi-Omics, and Multimodal Integration in Precision Radiotherapy for Head and Neck Cancer
articles.summary: This review explores how integrating AI, multi-omics, and multimodal clinical data can enhance precision in radiotherapy for head and neck cancers. It discusses the current state of research and the challenges of linking these technologies to clinical decision-making.

articles.title: Scintillating Micro-Probe Detectors for Conventional and FLASH Proton Dosimetry
articles.summary: This article discusses the characterization of optical fiber-based inorganic scintillating detectors for use in proton beams. The research addresses challenges in modeling optical transport and geometry for high-flux and FLASH delivery conditions.

articles.title: A cascade deep learning network for simultaneous prediction of dose and linear energy transfer in proton therapy of prostate cancer
articles.summary: This research introduces a deep learning framework designed to predict both dose and dose-averaged linear energy transfer (LETd) distributions for prostate proton therapy. The model aims to support LET-aware treatment planning and evaluation in clinical practice.

articles.title: Skill mix redesign in Italian radiation oncology: A technical note on advanced practice radiation therapists
articles.summary: This technical note discusses the implementation of Advanced Practice Radiation Therapists (APRTs) in Italy. It argues that such roles serve as a strategic workforce management tool to support medical decision-making and improve departmental workflow resilience.

articles.title: Radiation-induced brain necrosis among patients with nasopharyngeal cancer treated with proton vs photon radiotherapy
articles.summary: A study comparing the incidence of radiation-induced brain necrosis in nasopharyngeal carcinoma patients treated with proton versus photon therapy. Findings indicated no statistically significant difference in necrosis risk or survival outcomes between the two modalities.

articles.title: Differences in Biological Responses to Ultra-high Dose Rate Proton Irradiation Between Entrance and SOBP Regions In Vitro
articles.summary: This study examines the biological impact of ultra-high dose rate proton irradiation at different depths. Researchers observed dose-rate-dependent survival differences in the entrance region, suggesting that the radiobiological effects of FLASH proton therapy may vary based on the irradiation depth.
